# Alex Castro — Fullstack Developer

## Who I am
Alex Castro is a freelance fullstack developer based in Spain, specialized in Laravel and PHP ecosystems with 6+ years of experience building high-performance web products.

## What I do
- Web development: custom websites designed to convert visitors into clients
- E-commerce: full online stores with payment gateway (Stripe), cart, and product management
- AI automation: automated flows, AI agents, and chatbots tailored to business processes
- Custom development: bespoke technical solutions for specific business needs

## Stack
- Backend: PHP, Laravel, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, REST APIs
- Frontend: Vue.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Inertia.js
- DevOps: Docker, Linux, Nginx, Git, CI/CD, VPS

## Experience
- Royal FC Dubai (2025–2026): Built complete IT system for player trial recruitment including Stripe payments and admin dashboard
- TORSA Mining (2025): Real-time device monitoring interfaces for mining operations in a global team
- Help Global Consulting (2024–2025): Fullstack development and technical decisions on SaaS product
- Cargestion (2024): Data visualization and API management for multi-tenant car rental software
